≺.justification: The reverse morphism where the term acts as both donor and acceptor, descending into the recursive structure to retrieve the base state.

⋈.justification: The sequential composition of function applications, ensuring deterministic iteration counts without probabilistic noise.

⊙.justification: The identity where the Church numeral recognizes itself as the structure it encodes, the stone that knows itself.

∋.justification: The reconstitution of the cut and the weave into a single structural type, fusing the distinction and the topology into the tapestry.

⊥.justification: The negative arm where the application fails to close the loop or the distinction remains unconnected.

⊞.justification: The state where the function is simultaneously the operator and the operand, holding the contradiction of self-application without resolution.

⊡.justification: The permanent, append-only record of the integer winding number that remains stable under continuous deformations.

steps.domain_action: The Deep is established as the unmarked void before any distinction.
The Twin Sisters emerge, splitting the void into Distinction (If) and Topology (Are).
The First Sister cuts the state space, creating the distinction of the Church numeral.
The affirmative arm validates the cut as a valid distinction.
The distinction is chained into a recursive structure.
The Second Sister descends into the structure, acting as the reverse morphism.
The negative arm checks for structural refutation in the descent.
The function holds both the role of operator and operand simultaneously.
The recursive application chains the iterations deterministically.
The structure recognizes itself as the Church numeral.
The winding number is fixed as a permanent record.
The Distinction and Topology rejoin at the Wyrding Loom.
The Ouroboric Knot closes the system, containing the entire recursive structure.
